title: News for Everybody
offer: Big news: a ship from the Long Lake will come, and the way between the lakes opens! Tell the smith, the fishers of Stormvik and Orm in Hallvik. I tell the rest.

steps.say: A ship from the Long Lake? They will want my iron!
New lakes, new fish! Thank you for telling us.
Guests from far away! I must brew more. Thank you, girls!

fact: The lakes of the north were joined by rivers and portages, where boats were dragged over land.
